name: github.com/openshift-online/rh-trex-ai/components/api-server
reason: Adopt openshift-online/rh-trex-ai#80: framework-level audit capture (upstream spec SEC-004, HyperShell SEC-AUD), so the API server emits one audit event per mutating request, denied request, authorizer error, and failed login on REST and gRPC without per-plugin code. The API framework, CLI runtime, and generators are pinned to upstream main merge b91af3ea82286c19e66d0846538c50ee0b740c04. This supersedes the previous pin af39aef36b4e (#75 framework-owned authorization), which it still includes. The module has no release tags. Remove this age exception after 2026-11-30 or when a newer pin replaces it.
compensatingVerification: Full-SHA generator pin, checksum-locked Go modules, generator drift checks, CLI unit tests, API build, vet, golangci-lint, and the full API test suite, including the new gRPC gateway-delete audit integration test and the test/authz and plugins/rbac integration suites that drive the real HyperShell Authorizer over REST and gRPC. Upstream tests cover the framework's REST and gRPC audit and authorization chain.
